question: Can gene content predict whether a phosphonate pathway proceeds via 2-AEP or 2-HEP?
why: Both branch from phosphonoacetaldehyde, so the split is a real fork in phosphonate biosynthesis and one the report does not currently express. The coupling-enzyme class already names the fate of phosphonoPYRUVATE; this names the fate of its product.

PhnW.note: Swiss-Prot reviewed. Catabolic direction (AEP -> phosphonoacetaldehyde); the biosynthetic AepZ is the same enzyme family, and the Ppd gate plus antiSMASH region membership keep degradation operons out of scope.

PhpC.note: Swiss-Prot reviewed, from the phosphinothricin tripeptide cluster.

decision_rule.gate: Ppd (ThDP decarboxylase) must be present -- without it there is no phosphonoacetaldehyde

rules.Ppd absent: not via PnAA (synthase / direct transaminase / direct reductase route)

decision_rule.why_the_gate_is_load_bearing: 19 of 228 Pantoea/Winslowiella regions carry an Aminotran_5 with NO Ppd. Those are not AEP clusters, and a bare presence/absence rule would mis-call every one.

headline_finding.what: B. fragilis splits 81 regions AEP / 57 regions HEP with ZERO co-occurrence of the two branch markers across all 143 regions, every one of which is Ppd-positive.
headline_finding.why_it_is_not_an_artefact: A promiscuous marker would co-occur. None does. The split is bimodal within a single species.

validation.VlpB_vs_PhpC_discrimination: The 12 Fe-ADH proteins sampled from B. fragilis phosphonate regions hit PhpC at 32.3% identity / 55% coverage / bit 102, and hit VlpB NOT AT ALL, even at e-value 10. So these are phosphonoacetaldehyde reductases, not phosphonopyruvate reductases -- the 2-HEP call is discriminating rather than picking the nearer of two similar references.
validation.AEP_branch_hits: B. fragilis, B149 and the LMG 5342 phosphonolipid all hit PhnW at 35-42% identity and 96% coverage, bitscore 184-192.
validation.negative_control: LMG 5342 region 1 (pantaphos, synthase route) hits NEITHER reference. A classifier that labelled everything AEP or HEP would be useless; this one correctly declines.
validation.coverage_caveat: The PhpC hits are 55% coverage against 96% for PhnW, so the HEP call rests on a partial-length match. Worth a profile HMM if it is to carry weight.

open.no_confirmed_2HEP_positive_control: The two S. hygroscopicus regions available carry PhnW-like transaminases, not PhpC. The bialaphos producer is a specific strain, not the species, so these are not PTT clusters and cannot serve as the 2-HEP positive control. B. fragilis supplies the only PhpC-like proteins measured so far.
open.not_yet_wired: The classifier and report columns are designed but not implemented.
